name: Firing Line
strategy: Maintain ranged superiority through coordinated shooting, accuracy, and fire discipline.

commands.name: Concentrated Fire
commands.effect: One friendly Unit that has not voluntarily Moved, Disengaged, or Blinked this Round gains +2 Attacks on its next ranged Attack this Phase.

commands.name: Marked Fire Lane
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains Pinpoint and Accurate 2 on its next ranged Attack this Phase.

commands.name: Artillery Correction
commands.effect: One friendly Unit making a Heavy ranged Attack gains Accurate 2 and reduces the target's effective Cover X by 1 (minimum 0) against its target.

commands.name: Veteran Gunners
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains +1 Attack and Accurate 1 on its next ranged Attack against an enemy that was already attacked at range by a different friendly Unit this Round.

commands.name: Screening Fire
commands.effect: When an enemy within range of a friendly Unit's ranged weapon declares a Charge, the enemy worsens Hit by one step on its first Engagement Attack during the ensuing Combat Phase.

doctrineIdentity: Offensive ranged combat. Firing Line is especially effective with conventional archers, gun lines, and artillery but remains usable by any Unit possessing a ranged weapon.
